exploit: The route calls deleteReport directly without requireSession, so any caller can delete any report by id; every sibling route in src/router.ts calls requireSession first.

listReports filters by an owner prefix, so reports belong to owners, but deleteReport takes a bare id and readReport knows nothing about owners -- a caller who passes the session check still deletes another owner's report.
mitigation: Pass the session owner into deleteReport and unlink only a report that owner owns.
